text:
Maya: quick postmortem follow-up from today's incident (11:32 model-serving spike). Root cause: parallel canaries + KV-cache warming created short-lived p99 saturation. We agreed we need stronger rollout controls (blast radius + server-side filtering) and an auto-rollback flow. Notes: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-20240611

Sam: thanks. can we list concrete action items + owners here? I can own the auto-rollback design + initial impl.

Leo: i'll take the blast-radius feature-flag work and add server-side filters so we can target by tier/region. estimate ~2w for minimal safe rollout with tests.

Nora: i'll update the runbook with a canary-sizing playbook and add a short QA checklist. Q: prefer server-side flags or client-side sampling for canaries?

Maya: prefer server-side for determinism and auditability. ACTIONS:
- ACTION-PLAT-1: Auto-rollback watcher + rollout-controller (design PR + impl) - owner: Sam - due: 2024-06-25
- ACTION-PLAT-2: Feature-flag blast-radius controls (server-side) + migration + unit tests - owner: Leo - due: 2024-06-28
- ACTION-PLAT-3: Canary sizing playbook + runbook entry + QA checklist - owner: Nora - due: 2024-06-21
- ACTION-PLAT-4: Canary SLA alert + rollback integration (oncall play) - owner: eng-oncall - due: 2024-06-21

Sam: implementation note: auto-rollback is two parts: (1) metric watcher that evaluates p50/p95/p99 + error_rate over evaluation window, (2) rollout controller that triggers rollback with safety checks (no double-rollbacks, alerting, and audit log). i'll include a sample policy in the design PR.

Sam: sample policy sketch:
```
{
  "canary_pct": 5,
  "metrics": {"p99_latency_ms": 800, "error_rate": 0.01},
  "evaluation_window_secs": 300,
  "auto_rollback": true,
  "rollback_grace_secs": 30
}
```

Leo: agree server-side filters. i'll add a blast_radius param to the flag service and wire it to the rollout controller. we'll need a small migration to populate defaults.

Nora: client-side sampling makes telemetry messy for small canaries. server-side also helps for compliance customers. i'll draft the playbook with example canary sizes for different customer tiers.

deploy-bot: ticket created PLAT-4923 "auto-rollback + canary blast radius" assigned to Sam/Leo/Nora. https://redwood.internal/tickets/PLAT-4923

Maya: scheduling a 30-min sync next Wed 10:00 to review PRs, tests, and SRE dry-run checklist. pinging @Sam @Leo @Nora. Please include a minimal QA checklist so SRE can run a dry-run before enabling auto-rollback in prod. :thumbsup:

Sam: will add QA checklist and tag eng-sre in the PR. also will include a rollout simulation harness to validate watcher triggers in staging.

Leo: branch started for blast-radius flags, will post updates in #eng-platform and link PR to the ticket.

Nora: runbook entry uploaded and linked in PLAT-4923. added example metric thresholds and rollback steps.

Maya: thanks — i'll mark the incident follow-up as 'tracking' and will close the postmortem once PLAT-4923 has PRs, tests, and runbook linked. keeping an eye for any recurring pattern; ops asked to flag similar canary bursts in the past 90 days so we can check for trends.
